payload.summary: Reproduced min-size Electron mobile gate at a 1008 by 661 content viewport. Electron now bypasses the mobile-only gate, editor uses dynamic viewport height and actual content width, the Agent shrinks when docked and stays inside the window when floated, and the timeline toolbar scrolls without removing controls. Back is inline in page headers and tracks navigation history. Production Electron target built and the packaged native Windows test passed at display scales 100 and 125 percent, including minimum resize/reload, maximize/restore, floating Agent bounds, timeline control access and actual Back navigation. Chrome still applies its existing compact-screen notice. Eight targeted web tests passed. No deployment. Installed DIP cannot finalize due to unsupported project schema.
